title: Update and Get checkout session — DAY 3 SUBMISSION CHECKPOINT
context: This task closes out the minimum submittable MVP for the Sept 5 deadline. Everything from T1-T3 must work end-to-end after this task.
scope_in: POST /checkout_sessions/{id} accepting partial updates (line item changes, shipping address, discount code)
Recompute totals on every update, return full refreshed cart state
GET /checkout_sessions/{id} returns current state, 404 if session doesn't exist
Status transitions to updated on any successful update
scope_out: No complete/cancel logic yet — those are Day 4-5
acceptance_criteria: Update changing quantity of one line item returns correctly recomputed totals
GET on a nonexistent session id returns HTTP 404 with a clear error, not a 500
GET immediately after an update reflects the updated state, not stale data
FULL MVP CHECK: run create -> update -> get in sequence via curl or a short script, confirm state is consistent at every step — this is your submission-readiness gate
